name: Pod krylom lastochki
source:
The quiet harbor lived a peaceful life, but troubled times came: creatures of the dark current began to threaten the existence of its inhabitants and the settlers of other villages and towns.
The main heroine, the sharpshooter Disi, and her friends are involuntarily drawn into these events, and their fates becoming closely intertwined against the backdrop of the struggle against the forces of darkness.
